long_description:
Spooky, spirited yoga! Wear your favorite costume and enter our Halloween Costume Contest for a chance to win prizes.

About this Event

Celebrate Halloween with a fun and spirited Yoga Flow led by senior instructor Karen Munoz! Join us on Saturday, October 31st for an energizing practice that blends mindful movement, breath, and plenty of Halloween spirit.
Come dressed in your favorite costume and join our Halloween Costume Contest, with prizes for the best costumes! Whether your look is spooky, silly, creative, or completely unexpected, bring your Halloween spirit to the mat.
Costumes are encouraged, yoga-friendly, and ready to move!

Also check out other in Chicago, Health & Wellness events in Chicago, Contests in Chicago.
